issues.problem: coke_oven_batch_and_capacity never runs a Coke Oven and never reaches CokeOvenLogicMixin. The capacity cases are worked out with local arithmetic (`Math.min(16, Math.min(16, Math.min(remaining, 8000 / 500)))`, `Math.min(16, 499 / 500) == 0`) and a vanilla `ItemStack.isSameItemSameComponents` call. These assertions pass with or without the mixin. Nothing covers the in-progress insertion/extraction case or overflow at completion either.
issues.reason: The AC requires watching how many items a real oven processes when the output holds 0/1/60/64 Coke, when it holds a different item or different components, and when the Creosote tank has under 500 mB left. As written, the test only restates the formula, so the mixin goes unchecked. It is also unverified that redirecting the first `ItemStack.getCount()` call in `tickServer` (ordinal 0) changes the output-capacity term rather than some other count.
issues.fix: Build a formed IE Coke Oven in the GameTest, or create `CokeOvenLogic.State` and tick it through the multiblock context. Prefill the output slot and the Creosote tank for each case: Coke 0/1/60/64, named Coke, Charcoal, and a tank with less than 500 mB free. Insert 16 Bituminous Coal, tick it, then assert the input consumed, the Coke added and the Creosote added. For example, 60 Coke must take 4 inputs, and the 64-Coke, different-item, different-component and low-fluid cases must not start. Also move or extract output while a batch is running and assert nothing is lost or overfilled. If the ordinal-0 redirect does not hit the capacity term, retarget the mixin to the exact capacity expression.

issues.problem: This IE mixin uses the default remapping mode, unlike the other IE mixins in the project (`AllowInCrateMixin`, `DynamoBlockEntityMixin`, `TemplateMultiblockMixin`), which all specify `remap = false`. `IngredientFluidStack`, its `fluidIngredient` field and `getItems` are mod-owned names, so Mixin may remap the shadow field and injection target against Minecraft mappings and fail or target the wrong member outside the development environment.

issues.fix: Declare the mixin as `@Mixin(value = IngredientFluidStack.class, remap = false)`.
